# Open Keychain 3D

Open Keychain 3D is a browser-based, open-source customizer for printable 3D keychains,
nameplates, plant labels, and related small objects.

- Website: https://open-keychain.com/
- Customizer: https://open-keychain.com/create
- Privacy: https://open-keychain.com/privacy
- Source code: https://github.com/capynq/open-keychain
- License: MIT

## Templates

- https://open-keychain.com/templates/name-keychain/
- https://open-keychain.com/templates/articulated-name/
- https://open-keychain.com/templates/nameplate/
- https://open-keychain.com/templates/plant-label/

## Guides

- https://open-keychain.com/guides/stl-vs-3mf/
- https://open-keychain.com/guides/how-to-print-a-name-keychain/
- https://open-keychain.com/guides/articulated-vs-standard-keychain/
- https://open-keychain.com/guides/printable-plant-label-guide/

Geometry generation and STL/3MF export run locally in the browser. The project does not claim
physical-printer validation for every printer or material. The API server is optional and is not
required for the local-first customizer workflow.
